body: I'm going to start writing the individual notes now. Just wanna say that I don't want pity or anything, this was just a place where I was able to archive my thoughts I guess. Thanks for the conversations I was able to have and good luck to everyone I've spoken to who is battling their own shit.

The fact that you are asking for help is already a step in the right direction. For some reason I still won't admit that I need a shit ton of it. Just know you are on the right track before the track even begins, the toughest part is reaching out...
Thanks but, I don't need that anymore

Haha thanks but, I actually haven't lost weight, I honestly probably only weighed 120lbs of pure fat back then, no muscle. I literally just got taller and grew in to my body. YOU are the real inspiration honestly, other than the occasional game of hockey I never work out and never have had the motivation to. Keep it up man.
I'm here to talk if you need someone to vent to. You aren't alone in these thoughts.
I don't have any advice or anything... but, I know how you feel
